title: Cookies, sessions and browser storage
description: Understand how browser state, cookies and server-side sessions differ by testing an expiring in-memory session and secure cookie header.
objectives: Distinguish cookies, localStorage, sessionStorage and server-side records
Explain HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite and cookie expiration
Create an opaque random session identifier and enforce expiration
Explain why client-provided identity values never grant access
rubric: I compared cookies, localStorage and sessionStorage using documentation.
I explained why session IDs are not trusted user IDs.
I tested cookie attributes, expiration and revoked sessions.
